description: Payment-specific error codes and reason codes for LumiBase v0.1. All API errors use the wire shape { error: { code, message, requestId? } }. Cross-cutting codes (VALIDATION_ERROR, NOT_FOUND, UNAUTHORIZED, FORBIDDEN, CONFLICT, RATE_LIMITED, CONFIG_ERROR, INTERNAL_ERROR) are defined in packages/core.

PAYMENT_NOT_FOUND.description: No payment exists with the given ID for the authenticated application.

PAYMENT_EXPIRED.description: The payment request has expired and can no longer be confirmed.

PAYMENT_ALREADY_CONFIRMED.description: The payment is already confirmed. Confirm calls are idempotent and return the existing state.

PAYMENT_CANCELLED.description: The payment is cancelled and cannot be confirmed.

PAYMENT_INVALID_STATE.description: The payment is in a status that does not permit the requested operation.

PAYMENT_VERIFICATION_IN_PROGRESS.description: Another confirm call is currently verifying the same payment. The caller may retry after a short delay, or may read the payment status to observe the eventual outcome. This error is only returned under concurrent-confirm policy (b) described in specs/payments/lifecycle.json atomicity section; implementations that serialize confirms or return existing status instead may never emit it.

TRANSACTION_NOT_FOUND.description: No transaction with the given hash exists on the expected network.

TRANSACTION_REVERTED.description: The transaction exists but reverted on chain. The payment request itself remains pending; a different transaction may be submitted.

TRANSACTION_ALREADY_PROCESSED.description: The transaction has already been associated with a payment and cannot be used for another. The payment request remains pending; a different transaction may be submitted.

TRANSACTION_WRONG_NETWORK.description: The transaction was observed on a different network than the payment expects.

TRANSACTION_WRONG_RECIPIENT.description: The transaction transferred tokens to a recipient different from the payment request. The payment request remains pending; a different transaction may be submitted.

TRANSACTION_WRONG_TOKEN.description: The transaction transferred a token different from the payment request. The payment request remains pending; a different transaction may be submitted.

TRANSACTION_WRONG_SENDER.description: The transaction was sent from an address different from the specified payer. The payment request remains pending; a different transaction may be submitted.

TRANSACTION_NOT_ENOUGH_CONFIRMATIONS.description: The transaction is mined but has fewer confirmations than the chain policy requires. The payment request remains pending; the same transaction may be resubmitted once more confirmations are available.

TRANSACTION_RPC_FAILURE.description: The blockchain RPC endpoint could not be reached or returned an error. The payment request remains pending; the caller may retry the same transaction hash.

UNSUPPORTED_CHAIN.description: The chain ID is not supported or is currently disabled.

UNSUPPORTED_TOKEN.description: The token address is not registered for this chain.

WEBHOOK_INVALID_ENDPOINT.description: The webhook endpoint URL is not permitted (loopback, private network, invalid scheme, or other prohibited destination).

reasons.description: Reason codes attached to payment.failed events. Reserved for v0.2+ because failed is unreachable through v0.1 confirm. Distinct from API error codes: reasons describe the failing payment outcome; API codes describe the failing request.
